address: 2b North View, Westbury Park, City of Bristol, BS6 7QB, United Kingdom
bio: This neighbourhood bistro’s authentic Gallic feel will warm your soul. It’s family owned and run and is certainly a busy place, with visitors being warmly welcomed as if they were regulars. Well-executed dishes are fresh and hearty with a rustic style and bags of flavour; in the evening go for one of their sharing dishes. Service is friendly; ask for a booth beside the semi-open kitchen....
